notes:
- Add **Animated word highlighting** in **Settings → Lyrics → Appearance**. Turn it off to highlight each timed word immediately.
- Add **Now Playing audio spectrum** in **Settings → Appearance → Effects**. Turn it off to show the static waveform. **Audio info** and **Get Info** work in both modes.
- Show the release year from track metadata in **Now Playing** when available.
- Keep the spectrum bars a fixed width as their height follows the audio.

Bug reports and feature requests are tracked in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/sashokey/muzika/issues).

Home scrolling may still stutter while the **Shuffle** animation is visible.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
